summary: Urges the Nashville Department of Transportation and Multimodal Infrastructure and the Mayor's Office to renew and speed up Vision Zero work to end pedestrian deaths, after at least 20 pedestrian and cyclist deaths so far in 2026. It asks the department to work with the Vision Zero Advisory Council on a new five-year plan focused on the High Injury Network, and to report to the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee before December 30, 2026.
